note: Reference definitions for the two Retell custom functions. Create them in Retell (Functions > Add > Custom Function) using these values. Replace YOUR_N8N with your n8n Cloud domain. Keep 'Payload: args only' OFF so the body is { name, call, args }. Add the header X-Receptionist-Secret with the same value as the n8n 'Retell tool secret' credential.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Get the next open appointment times for a service. Call this after you know which service the caller wants, and before offering times.

preferred_date.description: Earliest date the caller wants, as YYYY-MM-DD (convert words like 'tomorrow' using the current date). Omit if they have no preference.

part_of_day.description: Morning or afternoon preference, if the caller gave one.

service.description: The service name exactly as listed. For several services in one visit join them with ' + '.

preferred_time.description: If the caller named a specific time, that time in 24-hour HH:MM local time (for example 11:00 or 14:00). Omit otherwise. When you use this, also set preferred_date.

purpose.description: 'booking' (default) to find appointment times. 'callback' to find times the shop can phone the caller back, used when the caller chose a callback.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book the appointment the caller chose. Call it as soon as the caller has picked one of the offered times and you have their name and phone number. Do not ask permission first.
tools.execution_message: One moment while I book that.

start.description: The exact 'start' value from check_availability for the time the caller chose.

phone.description: Callback phone number, exactly as the caller said it.

problem.description: The service(s) booked, for example the same text as service.

service.description: The service name exactly as listed. For several services in one visit join them with ' + '.

language.description: Language code the call was held in, e.g. 'en' or 'es'.

barber.description: The barber the caller asked for, if any. This is only a request.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Email the shop a callback request for a caller who wants something the assistant cannot handle (a question it cannot answer, a complaint, a business inquiry). Use only after the caller agrees to a callback.
tools.execution_message: Let me send that to the office.

phone.description: Callback phone number, exactly as the caller said it.

service.description: The service the call is about, or what it is about in a few words.

problem.description: Short description of what the caller needs, in their words.

preferred_callback_time.description: When the caller would like the call back, in their words (for example 'tomorrow afternoon').

callback_date.description: The day the caller wants the call back, as YYYY-MM-DD (convert 'tomorrow' etc. using the current date). Omit if they have no preference or want it as soon as possible.

callback_time.description: The time of day for the call back in 24-hour HH:MM, in the business's local time (for example 14:00). Omit if they have no preference.

tools.name: check_appointment
tools.description: Look up the caller's upcoming appointments by name and phone number. Use when a caller wants to check, cancel, or reschedule an appointment they already have. Returns each appointment's eventId, time and service.

name.description: The caller's full name as the appointment was booked.

phone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked under, exactly as the caller said it.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel one of the caller's appointments. Only call after check_appointment found it AND the caller clearly confirmed they want it cancelled.
tools.execution_message: One moment while I cancel that.

event_id.description: The eventId of the appointment, exactly as returned by check_appointment.

name.description: The caller's full name as the appointment was booked.

phone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked under, exactly as the caller said it.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move one of the caller's appointments to a new time. Only call after check_appointment found it and the caller picked a new time that check_availability offered.
tools.execution_message: One moment while I move that.

event_id.description: The eventId of the appointment, exactly as returned by check_appointment.

name.description: The caller's full name as the appointment was booked.

phone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked under, exactly as the caller said it.

new_start.description: The exact 'start' value from check_availability for the new time the caller chose.
